scope: Theorem 2.8 (Converse and sharp examples) of the manuscript “A Charged Reduction of the Spacetime Penrose Inequality in Spatial Dimensions at Least Four” (preprints/A-Charged-Reduction-of-the-Spacetime-Penrose-Inequality-in-Spatial-Dimensions-at-Least-Four-October-5-2026/paper.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 260 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 3e5e445d305051a1), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 8. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: Let M > |q0| and let a smooth spacelike exterior hypersurface of (2.20) have boundary a full section of the corresponding future horizon or its bifurca- tion sphere. Suppose its induced normalized initial data satisfy all the hypotheses of Definitions 2.1 and 2.6, including the vanishing induced magnetic two-form, and suppose its actual invariant ADM mass and signed electric flux are M and q0. Then Amin = Areag(S) = ω ( M + √ M2 − q2 0 )(n−1)/(n−2) , (2.22) and equality holds in Theorem 2.5. For every n ≥ 4 and every M > |q0|, static examples and admissible examples with nonzero second fundamental form exist.
